node.statement: With P=theta(X)=(I+S)/2, the identities S^2=I and S1=1 give P^2=P and P1=1, so P is an exact signed idempotent by def-signed-idempotent; moreover P-Q=(S-X)/2, so ||P-Q||_{inf->inf} <= C eta, and because Q is entrywise nonnegative row-stochastic by def-stochastic, each negative entry of P is bounded by the corresponding row error, giving delta(P) <= ||P-Q||_{inf->inf} <= C eta.
